note: Prices are read from the providers' official pages on the date shown. Spend is computed from the usage each API bills (response usage objects), never from local token counts. Re-check before a paid run; a changed price is recorded, not silently applied.

claude-haiku-5-5.reasoning_note: Adaptive thinking cannot be turned off on Claude Haiku 5.5 (thinking type disabled returns 400); it is steered with output_config.effort (low here), counts toward max_tokens and is billed inside output_tokens.
claude-haiku-5-5.tokenizer_note: Claude 4.7 and later models use a tokenizer that produces about 30% more tokens for the same text than earlier models; the projection scales the plan's token assumptions by 1.3 for this model. Billing always uses the API's usage.
